name: CI with gz-physics

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "**"
    paths-ignore:
      - ".github/workflows/cache_*.yml"
      - "docker/dev/**"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "**"
    paths-ignore:
      - ".github/workflows/cache_*.yml"
      - "docker/dev/**"
  schedule:
    # Cron syntax: [minute hour day_of_the_month month day_of_the_week]
    - cron: "0 2 * * 0,3" # Run every Sunday and Wednesday at 02:00
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test-gz-physics:
    name: Test with gz-physics
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        build_type: ["Release"]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout DART
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: dart

      - name: Setup pixi
        uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.8.14
        with:
          cache: true

      - name: Install DART dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libeigen3-dev \
            libassimp-dev \
            libfcl-dev \
            libfmt-dev \
            coinor-libipopt-dev \
            libbullet-dev \
            libode-dev \
            liboctomap-dev \
            libtinyxml2-dev \
            liburdfdom-dev \
            libxi-dev \
            libxmu-dev \
            freeglut3-dev \
            libopenscenegraph-dev \
            libspdlog-dev

      - name: Build and install DART
        run: |
          cd dart
          pixi run install

      - name: Checkout gz-physics
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gazebo-tooling/gz-physics
          path: gz-physics
          ref: main

      - name: Install gz-physics dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libgz-cmake3-dev \
            libgz-common3-dev \
            libgz-fuel-tools8-dev \
            libgz-msgs10-dev \
            libgz-rendering6-dev \
            libgz-sensors8-dev \
            libgz-transport10-dev \
            libgz-utils2-dev \
            libignition-cmake3-dev \
            libignition-common3-dev \
            libignition-fuel-tools8-dev \
            libignition-msgs10-dev \
            libignition-rendering6-dev \
            libignition-sensors8-dev \
            libignition-transport10-dev \
            libignition-utils2-dev

      - name: Build gz-physics with DART
        run: |
          cd gz-physics
          mkdir build
          cd build
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} \
            -DWITH_DART=ON \
            -DDART_DIR=/usr/local/lib/cmake/DART \
            -DENABLE_TESTING=ON
          make -j$(nproc)
          make test
